ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
